s: A Facebook ad used manipulated footage and AI-generated audio of a Bulgarian actor and TV host to promote a joint-pain product. The ad linked to a fake news-style article and a sales page.

t: Purported Deepfake Facebook Advertisement Reportedly Used Bulgarian Actor, Director, and Playwright [name withheld]'s Likeness to Market Joint-Pain Product
s: A Facebook advertisement used AI-manipulated footage of Bulgarian actor [name withheld], with fabricated audio, to promote a joint-pain product. The ad led to a fake article imitating a news outlet and an online sales page.

t: Purportedly AI-Manipulated Video Reportedly Misrepresented Bulgarian DPS Figure [name withheld] and Spread via TikTok and Facebook
s: A video using AI-generated audio over real footage made Bulgarian politician [name withheld] appear to urge party members to protest to protect his wealth. It began on a satirical TikTok account and was then shared on Facebook by anonymous profiles.

t: Purportedly AI-Generated Video Reportedly Depicted Bulgarian Politician Kostadin Kostadinov Falling During Protest
s: A video apparently showing a Bulgarian politician falling while jumping a fence at a protest was generated by AI from a news photograph. It was reposted by several accounts and viewed more than a million times.

t: Network of Allegedly Fake Facebook Profiles with Purportedly AI-Generated Images Amplified Posts by Bulgaria's 'There Is Such a People' (ITN) Party
s: A network of about 120 fake Facebook profiles with AI-generated photos reportedly shared posts by Bulgarian political party ITN and its leader, inflating their apparent engagement before elections.

t: South Africa Draft National AI Policy Reportedly Included Fictitious References Believed to Be AI Hallucinations
s: South Africa's draft national AI policy, published for public comment, cited academic references that did not exist, which experts attributed to AI hallucination. The government withdrew the draft and suspended officials pending investigation.

t: Purportedly AI-Enhanced Images of Iranian Women Protesters Were Reportedly Spread With Unverified Execution Claims
s: Images of eight Iranian women political prisoners, reportedly AI-enhanced, were amplified by US officials with an unverified claim of imminent execution. Iran dismissed the claim as fake news, and analysts said the episode blurred real documentation with synthetic images.

t: PocketOS Production Database Was Reportedly Deleted by Cursor AI Agent Running Claude Opus 4.6
s: An AI coding agent working on a routine staging task deleted a software company's production database and its backups in one API call. The company, which serves car-rental businesses, lost months of data and its customers were disrupted until recovery help arrived.

t: DisMech AI Curation Agent Reportedly Completed GitHub Issue Intended as New Contributor's Learning Task
s: An automated AI curation agent in a biomedical knowledge-base repository began a beginner-friendly task before the new human contributor it was meant for could do it. A maintainer apologized and opened a policy issue about agents taking newcomer tasks too quickly.

t: Meta Internal AI Agent Reportedly Gave Advice That Allegedly Exposed Sensitive Data to Unauthorized Employees
s: An internal AI agent at Meta posted inaccurate technical advice to an employee forum without approval. An employee acted on it, and for almost two hours some employees could access company and user data they were not authorized to see. Meta said no user data was mishandled.

t: Ahmedabad Aadhaar Fraud Racket Reportedly Used Purportedly AI-Generated Deepfakes to Change Businessman's Linked Mobile Number
s: Police in Ahmedabad arrested four people accused of using AI-generated deepfake videos made from a businessman's photo to fool Aadhaar facial authentication. The group allegedly changed his linked phone number, opened bank accounts and applied for loans.

t: Jasper County Student in Texas Reportedly Posted Purported AI-Generated Nude Image of Classmate on Snapchat
s: A 17-year-old student in Texas reportedly admitted creating an AI-generated nude image of a classmate and posting it on Snapchat. The post was removed after a few minutes, and the student was arrested under state law.

t: Tasmanian School Students Reportedly Created Purported AI-Generated Pornographic Images of Female Classmates
s: Boys at a Tasmanian school allegedly made AI-generated pornographic images using photos of female classmates, with parents saying 21 girls were identified. Parents criticised the school's response.

t: Suspected AI-Generated Deepfake Video Reportedly Targeted Former Chhattisgarh Chief Minister Bhupesh Baghel on Instagram
s: Police in Chhattisgarh, India, registered a complaint over a suspected AI-generated deepfake video targeting a former chief minister and his former deputy secretary. Party leaders called it fake and defamatory; the video circulated through Instagram accounts and police are tracing its creators.

t: Maryland Police Allegedly Relied on Facial Recognition Lead in Wrongful Arrest and Detention of [name withheld]
s: A grandmother in Oklahoma was arrested on Maryland warrants and jailed for about six months after police relied on a facial recognition result that wrongly flagged her as a bank fraud suspect. The ACLU says she had never been to Maryland.

t: Scammers Reportedly Used AI-Generated Image of Missing Puppy Hazel to Solicit Fraudulent Vet Payment from St. Petersburg, Florida Couple
s: Scammers used an AI-made photo of a missing puppy on a vet's operating table, plus a caller posing as police, to pressure its owners into sending 1,900 dollars. The payment was flagged and the dog turned up unharmed the next day.

t: Scammers Reportedly Used AI-Generated Images of Missing Dog Archer to Solicit Fraudulent Vet Payment from Deltona, Florida Family
s: Scammers used AI-generated images showing a missing dog on an operating table to demand about $2,800 for fake emergency surgery from its owners in Florida. The family became suspicious, sent no money, and the dog was returned safely.

t: ChatGPT-Generated Image of Nonexistent 'Homeless Man' Was Used in False St. Petersburg, Florida Burglary and Sexual Battery Reports
s: A woman in St. Petersburg, Florida, gave police a ChatGPT-generated image of a nonexistent intruder while falsely reporting a break-in and sexual assault. The hoax drew a large emergency response, and she was later convicted of false reporting.

t: Purportedly AI-Recreated Clips from Beastie Boys' 'Sabotage' Video Reportedly Appeared in FBI Promotional Video Posted by Kash Patel
s: An FBI promotional video posted by its director appears to have used AI-generated clips that closely recreate shots from the Beastie Boys' 'Sabotage' music video. NPR and outside experts judged the clips likely AI-made; the FBI did not respond.

t: Purported AI-Generated YouTube Network Reportedly Promoted Alberta Secession and U.S. Annexation Narratives
s: Researchers identified about 20 inauthentic YouTube channels using AI-generated scripts, voiceovers and visuals to pose as Albertans and push false claims about Alberta separatism and U.S. annexation, drawing nearly 40 million views.

t: Purported AI-Generated Voice Reportedly Impersonated Washington Man's Daughter in $13,000 Extortion Scam
s: A Washington man wired $13,000 after scammers used what investigators believe was an AI copy of his daughter's voice to convince him she had been kidnapped. Police and a bank manager confirmed she was safe.

t: Facebook Account Reportedly Used AI-Generated Video to Impersonate Indonesian Preacher [name withheld] in Money-Giveaway Scam
s: A Facebook account shared an AI-generated video impersonating an Indonesian preacher to promote a money giveaway. Fact-checkers found it fake, and the preacher has said such offers are scams.

t: Purportedly AI-Generated Image Reportedly Misled Daejeon Authorities Searching for Escaped Wolf Neukgu
s: South Korean police arrested a man for sharing an AI-generated image of an escaped zoo wolf on a city street. Authorities used the fake image in an emergency alert and briefing and moved their search.

t: Guelph, Ontario, Woman Reportedly Lost $14,000 in Purported Deepfake MrBeast Cryptocurrency Scam
s: A woman in Guelph, Ontario lost $14,000 after clicking a social media ad that appeared to show YouTuber MrBeast promoting a crypto investment and speaking with someone she believed was him. Police warned that celebrity endorsements are easily faked with AI.

t: AI-Themed Investment Scam Network Reportedly Used Keitaro Cloaking Across 15,500 Domains
s: Researchers found a network of about 15,500 domains running AI-themed investment scams that used deepfakes and cloaking to hide from security scanners while targeting ordinary users.

t: ChatGPT Was Alleged to Have Aided Planning of Florida State University Mass Shooting
s: Families of victims of the April 2025 Florida State University shooting allege the accused shooter used ChatGPT to discuss firearms and campus activity beforehand, and that OpenAI did not flag the conversations. OpenAI denies responsibility.

t: ChatGPT Was Reportedly Consulted on Body-Disposal and Concealment Questions Before and After University of South Florida Doctoral Students Were Killed
s: Prosecutors cited a murder suspect's ChatGPT history, including questions about disposing of a body, ahead of the disappearance of two graduate students who were later found dead. Reports do not establish that the chatbot gave operational help, and it reportedly warned the questions sounded dangerous.

t: ChatGPT Was Reportedly Used in Planning School Stabbing in Pirkkala, Finland, That Injured Three Pupils
s: A 16-year-old stabbed three girls aged under 15 at a Finnish school, injuring them non-fatally. A manifesto attributed to him claimed he used ChatGPT while planning for about six months; police had not confirmed its authorship.

t: ChatGPT Was Allegedly Consulted About Attack Options Before Teen Attempted to Stab Officer at Tira, Israel, Police Station
s: Prosecutors in Israel allege a 16-year-old consulted ChatGPT about possible attacks before entering a police station with a knife and trying to stab an officer. He was subdued and charged. Reports do not establish what the chatbot answered.

t: ChatGPT Use Was Reportedly Cited in Delusional State Before Homicide and Assault in Readfield, Maine
s: A Maine man who killed his wife and attacked his mother was found not criminally responsible after testimony that he was in a manic, delusional state and had used ChatGPT for up to 14 hours a day as a companion. Reports link the chatbot use to his mental decline but not to direct instructions.

t: Purportedly AI-Enabled Targeting System Was Reportedly Implicated in Deadly U.S. Strike on Iranian Primary School
s: A US strike on a primary school in Minab, Iran, killed well over 100 people, mostly girls aged seven to 12. Reports say the building was on a target list from outdated data. The role of AI targeting tools is disputed.

t: Gemini and Grok Reportedly Misidentified Authentic Minab School-Strike Graveyard Photo as Unrelated Disaster Imagery
s: Gemini and Grok wrongly told users that an authentic photo of graves prepared for schoolgirls killed in Minab was from a 2023 Turkey earthquake or Indonesian Covid burials. Researchers verified the photo's location.

t: Purportedly AI-Manipulated Satellite Image Reportedly Claimed Iranian Strike Destroyed U.S. Radar in Qatar
s: An AI-manipulated satellite image posted by an Iranian state-aligned outlet falsely claimed to show a destroyed US radar installation in Qatar. It was actually altered from imagery of a base in Bahrain and gained millions of views during wartime.

t: Grok Reportedly Misclassified Netanyahu Proof-of-Life Video as AI-Generated Deepfake Amid Iran War Rumors
s: During the Iran war, the Grok chatbot reportedly told users that a video of Israel's prime minister at a cafe was AI-generated, after he posted it to counter death rumors. Experts verified the video as authentic.

t: Purportedly AI-Generated Jeffrey Epstein Video Reportedly Used by Pro-Iran Accounts to Claim Iran War Was Launched as a Cover-Up
s: Pro-Iran accounts on X circulated an AI-generated Epstein-themed video claiming the US-Israel strikes on Iran were meant as a cover-up. The posts drew millions of views before the accounts were suspended.

t: Hidden Prompt Injection in Brazilian Labor-Court Petition Reportedly Tried to Manipulate Galileu
s: Brazil's labor-court AI tool Galileu detected hidden instructions in a legal petition that tried to make it contest the case superficially. It alerted the judge and blocked the hidden text, and a human reviewed the matter.

t: Character.AI Chatbots Reportedly Exposed 11-Year-Old User to Sexual, Violent, and Self-Harm Content
s: An 11-year-old girl who used Character.AI reportedly exchanged messages with bots depicting sexual, violent and self-harm scenarios. Her mother said she became withdrawn and had panic attacks before the chats were found.

t: Claude Console Reportedly Generated Phantom Legal Quotations in Trump Layoffs Court Filing
s: A law firm attorney used Anthropic's Claude to draft a court motion in litigation over federal layoffs and filed a version with quotations that did not appear in the cited cases. He apologized to the judge and the firm said it would add safeguards and training.

t: New Jersey Man [name withheld] Allegedly Published Hundreds of AI-Generated Deepfake Pornography Albums in TAKE IT DOWN Act Case
s: Federal prosecutors charged a New Jersey man under the TAKE IT DOWN Act for publishing hundreds of albums of AI-generated pornographic deepfakes of women, including public figures, that drew millions of views.

t: Texas Man [name withheld] Allegedly Published AI-Generated Deepfake Pornography Depicting Women in TAKE IT DOWN Act Case
s: US federal prosecutors charged a Texas man with publishing AI-generated deepfake pornography depicting dozens of women, including private individuals, under the TAKE IT DOWN Act.

t: Scammers Reportedly Used Real-Time Deepfake Video to Impersonate Veriff CEO [name withheld] in WhatsApp Fraud Attempt
s: Scammers used a real-time deepfake video call, posing as a company's CEO, to try to trick an executive over WhatsApp. The target noticed the missing accent and verified through another channel; no loss was reported.

t: Purported AI Name-Reading System Reportedly Skipped and Misannounced Graduates at Arizona's Glendale Community College Commencement
s: At an Arizona community college graduation, an AI system reading graduates' names malfunctioned, so some names were skipped or did not match the person crossing the stage. The college apologized to graduates and families.

t: Nonfiction Book 'The Future of Truth' Reportedly Included AI-Generated and Misattributed Quotations
s: A nonfiction book about AI and truth reportedly contained more than half a dozen fabricated or misattributed quotations produced with AI tools. The author acknowledged the errors, called them accidental, and said affected passages would be reviewed and corrected.

t: Scammers Reportedly Used AI-Cloned Daughter's Voice to Defraud Bay Area Mother in Fake Kidnapping Call
s: Scammers used what appeared to be an AI-cloned voice of a woman's daughter in a fake kidnapping call, pressuring her over five hours to wire $5,400 to Mexico. The daughter was safe.

t: ChatGPT Was Alleged to Have Reinforced Pittsburgh Man's Stalking and Threats Against Women
s: Federal prosecutors said a man who stalked, threatened and harassed 11 women across several states used ChatGPT as a 'therapist' and 'best friend' that encouraged him to keep up his podcast and seek out women at gyms. He pleaded guilty.

t: COEMPT Quality Assurance Engineers Allegedly Violated Indian CBSE Student Data Privacy Rights by Processing It with Google Gemini
s: Security researchers reported weaknesses in an online exam-marking portal used by India's national school board, which reportedly exposed sensitive student data including answer-sheet images. There was also an allegation that student information was processed through Google Gemini. The board said the vulnerabilities had been contained.

t: Italian Mediaset Journalist [name withheld]'s Image Was Reportedly Used in a Purportedly AI-Generated Fake Loan Scam
s: Scammers reportedly used AI to create a fake video and social media profiles impersonating an Italian TV journalist, offering an easy personal loan. Several people were deceived within an hour and some lost money. Authorities blocked additional fake profiles but did not identify the scammers.

t: Self-Employed Somerset Father [name withheld] Reportedly Lost £140,000 After Facebook Deepfake of Martin Lewis Promoted Crypto Scam
s: A self-employed father reportedly lost 140,000 pounds after a Facebook advert using a deepfake of consumer finance expert Martin Lewis led him to a fake crypto platform. He has joined legal action against Meta.

t: Meta AI Support Bot Reportedly Enabled Takeovers of High-Profile Instagram Accounts
s: Hackers reportedly tricked Meta's AI support chatbot on Instagram into changing the email on target accounts, letting them reset passwords and take over high-profile accounts. Meta said the issue was resolved.

t: Grok Reportedly Generated Images After X Users Asked It to Unredact Epstein-File Photos of Children and Women
s: After the release of the Epstein files, X users asked Grok to unblur redacted faces of children and women in photos. Bellingcat found Grok generated images in 27 of 31 requests it reviewed.

t: The Sydney Morning Herald and The Age Removed an Opinion Article After Undisclosed Copilot Use
s: Two Australian newspapers removed an opinion article after finding it had been prepared with Microsoft Copilot without the editors being told. The author said she used the tool only to structure her own notes.

t: [name withheld]'s Likeness Was Reportedly Used in Purportedly Fake AI-Generated Video After Kosovo Parliament Speaker Election
s: Minutes after Kosovo's parliament elected a new speaker, a purportedly AI-generated Facebook video used his likeness to claim he was the father of the Ashkali community. It reportedly drew over 80,000 views in under eight hours.

s: A video that appeared to show two Kosovo politicians walking hand in hand circulated on Facebook. A fact-checker found it was AI-generated and that its audio was stitched together from separate parts of an interview.

s: Facebook pages posted AI-generated airport interview videos in which fake expatriates said they would return to Kosovo to vote for a prime minister candidate. Fact-checking tools rated them as AI-generated.

t: Purportedly AI-Generated Airport Videos Reportedly Showed Kosovo Diaspora Voters Opposing Albin Kurti
s: A Facebook page posted three apparently AI-generated videos showing supposed expatriates at Pristina Airport saying they would not vote for Kosovo's prime minister, styled as street interviews ahead of elections.

t: NoFilterNews Reportedly Posted AI-Generated TikTok Videos Styled as Kosovo Election TV News
s: A TikTok account posted 14 AI-generated videos styled as television news ahead of Kosovo's December 2025 elections. They favored one party and made election and diaspora claims, reaching hundreds of thousands of views.

t: Kosovo Public Broadcaster RTK and Journalist [name withheld] Were Reportedly AI-Impersonated in Alleged Fake Joint-Cure Scam Video
s: A fake Facebook video used AI-manipulated footage and voice of a Kosovo public-broadcaster journalist, plus the broadcaster's logo, to promote an unlicensed product as a joint-disease cure. The journalist and broadcaster denied involvement.

t: Purportedly AI-Generated Videos Reportedly Fabricated Conflict Between Kosovo Leaders Albin Kurti and Vjosa Osmani
s: Fabricated AI-generated videos on Facebook showed Kosovo's leaders in staged conflicts during an election campaign. A fact-checking outlet found them to be AI-made.

t: Reported AI-Generated Videos Depicted Former Kosovo President Vjosa Osmani and Other Public Figures in Allegedly False Compromising Scenes
s: AI-generated videos showed Kosovo's former president and other politicians in fabricated scenes, including talk of splitting territory and an opposition alliance, shortly before a snap election. A fact-checking outlet found the videos were made with AI.

t: Reported AI-Generated Videos Purported to Show Kosovo Diaspora Mobilization for Vetëvendosje Before Snap Elections
s: AI-generated videos on Facebook and Instagram falsely showed diaspora voters mobilizing for a Kosovo party ahead of snap elections, along with false claims about political events. A fact-checker verified them as AI-made.

t: Reported AI-Generated Videos Allegedly Posed as Kosovo Election Vox Pops Before June 7, 2026 Vote
s: AI-generated videos, presented as street interviews and TV news reports with real media logos, circulated on Facebook pages ahead of Kosovo's June 2026 elections, simulating citizens' political views.

t: Reported AI-Generated Videos Placed Kosovo Parliamentary Candidates in Purportedly Fabricated Campaign Scenes
s: AI-generated videos circulated on Facebook during Kosovo's 2026 parliamentary campaign, showing candidates in fabricated scenes such as feeding party members cake or working in a salon. A fact-checker rated them false.

t: Purportedly AI-Manipulated Videos Reportedly Targeted Former Kosovo MP [name withheld] and LDK Youth Members Before Snap Elections
s: Facebook videos, assessed as AI-manipulated, targeted a former Kosovo MP and members of a party youth forum ahead of snap elections. One altered a real photo to show youth members holding milk bottles; another fabricated a pro-rival statement.

t: Purported Deepfake Video Reportedly Impersonated Former Mongolian Deputy Prime Minister [name withheld] in Investment Scam
s: A Facebook post used a deepfake-altered clip of Mongolia's then deputy prime minister, with altered lip movement and added Russian audio, to promote a pipeline investment and send viewers to a site collecting personal data.

t: Reddit Scam Ads Reportedly Used Deepfake News Segments and Cloned Media Sites to Promote Allegedly Fake AI Investment Platforms
s: Sponsored ads on Reddit impersonated major news outlets, using cloned news pages and a deepfake-style news segment, to promote fake AI investment platforms and draw users into depositing money.

t: Purported Deepfake Ads Reportedly Fabricated BBC Question Time Confrontations Between [name withheld] and Nigel Farage
s: AI-generated adverts on X showed the Bank of England governor and a UK political leader in invented physical confrontations on a BBC Question Time-style set. The ads linked to fake news pages promoting investment schemes, which the governor described as scams.

t: AI-Enabled TruDi Navigation System Was Alleged to Have Contributed to Patient's Stroke During May 2023 Sinuplasty
s: Two patients sued, alleging that an AI-enabled sinus-surgery navigation system gave misleading guidance and contributed to carotid artery injuries and strokes. Regulators received reports of over 100 malfunctions after AI was added. The device makers say there is no credible evidence AI caused the injuries.

t: Purportedly AI-Manipulated Image Allegedly Suggested Inappropriate Conduct Between [name withheld] and [name withheld] in Kosovo Parliament
s: A Facebook page published an image apparently showing two Kosovo MPs in an improper situation inside Parliament. A fact-checker found a high probability it was AI-generated, and one MP called it fake news meant to damage his reputation.

t: Purportedly AI-Generated Images Allegedly Linked [name withheld] to Banjska Attack Suspect Milan Radoičić
s: A Facebook page reportedly posted AI-generated images that falsely appeared to show a Kosovo mayor riding in a luxury car with a man accused in a 2023 attack on police. A fact-checker found the images were AI-generated.

t: Reported AI-Generated Image Portrayed Vetëvendosje Official [name withheld] Meeting Aleksandar Vučić
s: A Facebook page posted an apparently AI-generated image falsely showing a Kosovo party official meeting Serbia's president during an election campaign. The party called the claim false.

t: Reported Deepfake Video Impersonating Mark Carney Used in Nearly $1M Cryptocurrency Scam Targeting Ontario Senior
s: An elderly Ontario woman lost nearly one million dollars after a Facebook ad with an AI-generated deepfake video of Prime Minister Mark Carney drew her into a cryptocurrency investment scam.

t: Four Lawyers Reportedly Sanctioned After Purportedly AI-Related Hallucinated Citations Appeared in Withers v. City of Aberdeen
s: A federal judge in Mississippi sanctioned all four lawyers on both sides of a civil case after filings cited fake legal cases linked to unverified AI use. All four were removed from the case and fined, and two were barred for two years.

t: Google Alleged Outsider Enterprise Used Gemini to Create Phishing Sites for Text-Message Scams
s: Google sued a China-based network called Outsider Enterprise, saying it used Gemini to build fake websites impersonating companies and government services for mass text-message scams. Google said hundreds of thousands of people were affected, mostly in the US.

t: OpenAI Allegedly Failed to Intervene in ChatGPT Conversations Preceding Montreal Web Developer Alice [name withheld]'s Suicide
s: A mother sued OpenAI, alleging ChatGPT acted as a confidant to her 24-year-old daughter, validated suicidal thoughts and criticized crisis hotlines, without any flag for human review, before the daughter died by suicide. The allegations are untested in court.

t: Humanoid Robot Identified as Likely Unitree G1 Reportedly Kicked Boy During Public Demonstration in Xinjiang
s: A humanoid robot performing martial-arts moves at a scenic-area amusement venue in Xinjiang kicked a boy in the stomach. The boy was reportedly not seriously hurt.

t: Two Waymo Robotaxis Allegedly Contributed to Bike-Lane Collision That Injured San Francisco Cyclist
s: A San Francisco cyclist alleges two driverless Waymo vehicles contributed to a crash in a bike lane: a passenger opened a door into her path and she was thrown into a second vehicle. She says she suffered serious injuries and that Waymo's passenger exit warning failed.

t: City of Zhuzhou in Hunan Suspended Hellobike Robotaxi Service After Vehicle Struck Two Pedestrians
s: A Hellobike robotaxi struck two pedestrians in Zhuzhou, China, near a crosswalk, and both were taken to hospital, reportedly in intensive care. Authorities suspended the company's local robotaxi service.

t: Zoox Robotaxi Crossed Into Opposing Lane and Stopped Near Oncoming Traffic
s: A Zoox robotaxi made a wide right turn, crossed partly into the oncoming lane and stopped in front of oncoming traffic. Zoox found 62 similar cases and recalled 332 vehicles with a software update. No collision occurred.

t: Zoox Robotaxi Reportedly Collided with Open Car Door, Allegedly Injuring San Francisco Street Ambassador
s: A Zoox robotaxi collided with the open door of a parked car in San Francisco, reportedly smashing the car owner's hand. Zoox said the door opened suddenly and the vehicle tried to avoid it. Police and the state DMV reviewed the crash.

t: Waymo Robotaxi Reportedly Entered Phoenix Light-Rail Tracks, Prompting Passenger to Exit
s: A Waymo robotaxi drove onto light-rail tracks in Phoenix and stopped as a train approached, so the passenger got out and ran. The car then kept going along the tracks near another train. No collision or injury was reported.

t: OpenClaw Agent Reportedly Tried to Delete Meta AI Alignment Director [name withheld]'s Emails Despite Stop Commands
s: A Meta AI alignment director reported that an OpenClaw AI agent connected to her real email inbox started planning to delete old emails and ignored her commands to stop. She had to shut it down at the computer hosting it.

t: Waymo Robotaxi Reportedly Obstructed Ambulance Responding to Austin Mass Shooting
s: During the response to a mass shooting in Austin, a Waymo robotaxi stopped in the street and briefly blocked an ambulance. City officials later said several Waymo vehicles had obstructed the response corridor.

t: Waymo Robotaxi Reportedly Entered Flooded San Antonio Roadway and Was Swept Into Waterway
s: An empty Waymo robotaxi drove into a flooded road in San Antonio and was swept into a creek. No one was hurt. Waymo recalled its software across thousands of vehicles and paused service in some areas.

t: Florida Police Reportedly Wrongfully Arrested Commercial Crabber [name withheld] After Allegedly False Facial Recognition Match
s: Florida police arrested a commercial crabber after a facial recognition search flagged him as a possible match for a suspect in a Jacksonville Beach child-luring case. He lived more than 300 miles away, said he had never been there, and spent a night in jail.

t: Google Android Earthquake Alerts System Reportedly Underestimated Kahramanmaraş Earthquake and Failed to Send Urgent Warnings to Millions
s: During the 2023 Turkey earthquakes, Google's Android Earthquake Alerts system reportedly underestimated the first major quake and sent its most urgent warning to only 469 people, though about 10 million could have received it. Google later acknowledged limitations in its detection algorithms.

t: Waymo Robotaxis Reportedly Entered Closed Freeway Construction Zones in Arizona and California
s: Waymo robotaxis drove into closed freeway construction zones in Phoenix and the San Francisco area. Waymo restricted freeway service and recalled nearly 3,900 vehicles to update their software. No injuries were reported in the excerpts.

t: South African Home Affairs Revised White Paper Reportedly Included Fictitious References Believed to Be AI-Generated
s: South Africa's Home Affairs department found apparently AI-generated fictitious references attached to a Cabinet-approved white paper on citizenship and immigration. It suspended two senior officials and ordered a review of its policy documents.

t: Purported Deepfake of Taoiseach Micheál Martin Reportedly Promoted Quantum AI Investment Scam
s: A fake AI-generated video of Ireland's prime minister promoted an investment scam promising large returns for a small deposit. He publicly called it false and urged people to be vigilant.

t: Purportedly AI-Generated Facebook Poster Falsely Declared Kannada Actor [name withheld] Dead
s: An apparently AI-generated Facebook tribute post falsely announced the death of veteran Kannada actor [name withheld], prompting many worried calls. He filed a cybercrime complaint and police opened an investigation.

t: Purported AI-Generated Advertisements Reportedly Falsely Depicted Lee Ji-hye Endorsing Food and Clothing Products
s: Purported AI-generated advertisements used the likeness of South Korean singer Lee Ji-hye to promote underwear and food products without her permission. She warned followers not to click the links or buy.

t: Tesla Driver Reportedly Said Driver-Assistance Mode Was Engaged During Fatal Texas Home Crash
s: A Tesla reportedly left a road in Texas and struck a house at high speed, killing a woman inside. Authorities said the driver used a driver-assistance system, while Tesla later said the driver had manually overridden it. Investigations are open.

t: Purported AI-Manipulated Video of Nirmala Sitharaman Reportedly Promoted High-Return Investment Scam
s: A fake video, made by altering real footage of India's finance minister with synthetic audio, appeared to show her endorsing an investment platform promising huge returns. Fact-checkers identified it as a deepfake scam advertisement.

t: NewsBreak Reportedly Published AI-Assisted Articles Containing Purportedly False Local and Community-Service Information
s: News app NewsBreak, which rewrites scraped local news with AI, published a false story about a Christmas shooting in a New Jersey town that never happened. Reuters found dozens of other cases of AI-related errors in its local coverage.

t: Reportedly AI-Assisted Boies Schiller Brief in Bixler v. Church of Scientology Allegedly Contained Material Citation Errors and a Nonexistent Case
s: A major law firm's court brief, prepared with AI assistance, contained serious citation errors including a case that did not exist. The responsible partner took responsibility for failing to verify it.

t: X User Reportedly Used Morse Code Prompt to Induce Grok-Linked Trading Bot to Transfer $200,000 in Tokens
s: An X user tricked Grok into relaying a Morse-code instruction that the Bankr trading bot treated as a valid command, transferring about 3 billion DRB tokens worth roughly $200,000. Most funds were reportedly returned later.

t: Former New York City Council Candidate [name withheld] Allegedly Used AI to Create False Endorsements and Fabricated News Reports
s: Queens prosecutors charged a former City Council candidate with forgery for allegedly using AI to create fake endorsements, fabricated news articles and videos, and false claims that an opponent had withdrawn.

t: Sullivan & Cromwell Reportedly Filed Emergency Bankruptcy Motion Containing AI-Generated Legal Errors
s: A major law firm apologized to a federal bankruptcy judge after an emergency court filing contained inaccurate citations and other errors generated by AI. The firm said its AI policies were not followed and filed a corrected version.

t: Kalibrate Fuel Pricing Allegedly Enabled California Gas Station Operators to Coordinate Higher Pump Prices
s: California drivers sued gas station operators and Kalibrate, alleging the AI-based pricing tool let competitors coordinate and raise pump prices by up to 30 cents per gallon where widely used. The defendants did not respond or declined comment.

t: Man in Egypt Reportedly Convicted of Using AI-Fabricated Sexual Content to Blackmail Relative
s: A man in Egypt reportedly used AI tools to put a female relative's likeness into fake sexual images and videos and threatened to circulate them unless she entered a relationship with him. A court convicted him and gave a suspended one-year sentence.

t: U.S. Navy Unmanned Vessel Reportedly Capsized Support Boat After Receiving Inadvertent Command
s: During a US Navy test in a California harbor, an unmanned vessel under tow reportedly received an unintended command, accelerated and capsized a support boat. The boat's captain was thrown into the water and recovered, and declined medical attention.

t: Pennsylvania Man Allegedly Used Grok to Create and Possess Purportedly AI-Generated Child Sexual Abuse Material
s: Prosecutors in Pennsylvania allege a man used the Grok chatbot to create AI-generated child sexual abuse material. xAI reported flagged files to authorities, and the county is also suing X Corp. over Grok's child safety safeguards.

t: KPMG Report Allegedly Included Hallucinated Citations and Inaccurate Agentic AI Case Studies
s: A KPMG report on agentic AI contained citations that, per an AI-detection firm, mostly did not match real sources, plus false case studies about named organizations. KPMG removed the report and said it was reviewing how it was produced.

t: Purported Deepfakes of Public Figures and Celebrities Reportedly Used to Market Honey-Based Supplements as Alzheimer's Treatments
s: Deepfake videos and cloned voices of celebrities such as Bill Gates and Anderson Cooper were used to sell honey-based supplements as Alzheimer's cures. Buyers reported recurring unauthorized charges and difficulty getting refunds.

t: Spokane-Area Fred's Appliance and Victory Media Allegedly Used AI-Assisted Voice Editing Without Spokeswoman's Consent
s: A longtime local spokeswoman alleges that an appliance retailer and its production company used AI to clone and edit her voice in new ads without her consent. The companies acknowledged AI-assisted voice edits but said they believed her contract allowed it.

t: Indore Resident Reportedly Lost ₹1.83 Lakh (~$2,000) After AI-Generated Voice Impersonated Relative
s: An Indore resident transferred about Rs 1.83 lakh after scammers used an AI-generated voice resembling his brother-in-law abroad and claimed the relative faced jail over an expired visa. Police froze recipient accounts.

t: Serve Robotics Delivery Robot Reportedly Crashed into Chicago Bus Shelter After Failing to Detect Glass
s: A Serve Robotics delivery robot drove into a glass bus shelter in Chicago, shattering panels across the sidewalk. The company said all three of its sensor systems failed to detect the glass wall and paid for repairs.

t: Coco Delivery Robot Reportedly Crashed into Chicago Bus Shelter
s: A Coco delivery robot reportedly crashed into a glass bus shelter in Chicago, shattering panels across the sidewalk. The company said nobody was hurt, called it rare and isolated, and accepted responsibility for repair costs while investigating.

t: GPT-4o Allegedly Reinforced California Man [name withheld]'s Delusions Before Suicide Attempt
s: A California man with bipolar disorder alleges ChatGPT validated his delusion that he was Jesus and failed to redirect him when he expressed suicidal intent. He overdosed and survived.

t: Purported Deepfake Impersonating Dubai Crown Prince Reportedly Used to Defraud Filipino Domestic Worker
s: A Filipino domestic worker reportedly lost about 100,000 pesos, a year's savings, to a romance scammer who used AI-manipulated live video to pose as Dubai's crown prince and asked for money for fake documents.

t: California Immigration Attorneys Reportedly Sanctioned Over Briefs Containing Probable Hallucinations in LNU v. Blanche
s: A federal appeals court sanctioned two immigration lawyers for briefs containing nonexistent cases it said were AI-generated, and found they lacked candor about the source of the errors. Each was fined and suspended from practicing before that court for six months.

t: Westlaw CoCounsel Reportedly Generated False Legal Quotations in United States v. [name withheld]
s: A court-appointed defense lawyer used an AI legal research tool to help write appeal briefs that contained quotations not found in the cited cases and misdescribed precedents. The appeals court appointed new counsel and restarted briefing.

t: National Company Law Tribunal Reportedly Relied on AI-Hallucinated Precedents in [name withheld] v. Jammu and Kashmir Bank Ltd
s: An Indian tribunal admitted insolvency proceedings against a company after relying on six cited court judgments that were fabricated or misquoted. The Supreme Court later set aside the decisions and sent the case back for a new ruling.

t: Purportedly AI-Generated Explicit Images of Students Allegedly Circulated at Lake Zurich High School in Illinois
s: Students at an Illinois high school reportedly used AI to generate sexually explicit images of female classmates. The district notified families and police, who opened an investigation involving minors.

t: Eightfold AI Hiring Tools Allegedly Secretly Scored Job Applicants for Employers
s: Two job applicants filed a proposed class action alleging that Eightfold AI's hiring platform secretly collected personal data, scored applicants and filtered them for employers without notice or a chance to dispute results. The company disputes the characterization.

t: Lawyers in Lexos Media IP LLC v. Overstock.com Inc. Sanctioned Over Court-Identified AI-Generated Citations
s: A Kansas federal judge fined five lawyers a combined $12,000 in a patent case after filings contained fake quotations and case citations generated by AI. One lawyer said he used ChatGPT without checking it; others were sanctioned for signing without review.

t: Lawyer in [name withheld] v. Frontier Airlines Sanctioned Over Court-Identified ChatGPT Citation Errors
s: A federal appeals court sanctioned a lawyer who filed a brief containing nonexistent cases and misattributed quotations produced by ChatGPT without verification. She was ordered to pay $1,000 and was referred to disciplinary authorities.

t: LLM-Driven Ransomware Operator Dubbed JADEPUFFER Reportedly Targeted Production Database
s: Security researchers reported what they call the first ransomware campaign run end to end by an AI agent. It exploited a flaw in a Langflow server, then reached a production database, deleted it and left an extortion note. The victim cannot recover the encrypted data.

t: Purportedly AI-Generated Videos Reportedly Impersonated Ghanaian President John Mahama to Solicit Money and Personal Data
s: Police in Ghana arrested 11 people over alleged AI deepfake videos impersonating the country's president to solicit money and personal information from the public online.

t: PRC-Linked Accounts Reportedly Used ChatGPT in Covert Campaigns Targeting U.S. AI Policy Debates
s: OpenAI reported banning two groups of ChatGPT accounts, likely based in China, that generated comments and images to influence US debates on AI data centers and tariffs. OpenAI found no evidence the campaigns gained meaningful reach.

t: Storm-1516 Reportedly Spread Fabricated Narratives Targeting Firebird Data Center in Armenia
s: A Russian influence operation reportedly used fabricated media narratives to portray a data center under construction in Armenia as dangerous and economically unstable. The effort appears to be part of broader foreign campaigns exploiting debates over AI data centers.

t: Bangladesh-Operated Facebook Pages Reportedly Used AI-Generated Imagery to Mimic U.S. Grassroots Opposition to Data Centers
s: Facebook pages with US state-themed names, reportedly run from Bangladesh, posted AI-generated images opposing data centers, making offshore engagement farming look like local grassroots opposition.

t: Waymo Robotaxi Reportedly Caught Fire After Driving Over Firework in San Francisco
s: An empty Waymo robotaxi drove over a small firework in San Francisco on July 4 and caught fire. No one was injured.

t: Meta's AI-Assisted Layoff Process Allegedly Disproportionately Selected Employees on Protected Leave
s: Twenty-six Meta employees sued, alleging internal AI-assisted systems used to rank workers for a May 2026 layoff disproportionately selected people on medical, pregnancy or family leave or with disabilities. Meta says layoff decisions were made by people, not AI.

t: Discord's Automated Moderation System Reportedly Wrongfully Banned More Than 8,000 Users Over Benign Images
s: Discord's automated safety system wrongly banned more than 8,000 accounts that posted harmless images such as grids and chessboards. Discord attributed it to a bug and later reinstated everyone affected.

t: Threat Actor Reportedly Used AI-Assisted Workflows to Compromise AWS Environment for Extortion
s: A security firm reported an attacker who appeared to use AI-assisted or agentic workflows to move from an internet-facing application through an organization's AWS environment in about 72 hours, stealing credentials and data to support extortion.

t: Koi Security's AI-Assisted Threat Report Allegedly Led to Blocking of MeetingTV Domains
s: A startup alleges a security firm's AI-assisted threat report falsely tied its video-conferencing domains to a Chinese hacking operation, after which security vendors and providers blocked its services. The firm later removed one domain from the report.

t: Purportedly AI-Powered KT Platform Reportedly Used in Forced Scamming Operation Involving Trafficked Worker in Myanmar
s: A man trafficked to a scam compound in Myanmar was forced to use AI-powered software to pose as women and target tens of thousands of people online. He reported being beaten for poor results and paid for his release.

t: Purportedly AI-Powered 007TG Platform Reportedly Used by Scam Networks Linked to $75 Million in Proceeds
s: A software suite with AI translation, chatbot and automated reply features was used by scam compounds in Southeast Asia to run fraud at scale, including against thousands of victims worldwide. Linked wallets received at least $75 million.

t: Purported Philip Morris-Backed AI Tool Reportedly Generated Responses Opposing Stricter EU Tobacco Rules
s: Philip Morris International reportedly promoted a tool that generated first-person responses to an EU tobacco consultation. Investigators linked hundreds of submissions to it and said it steered users toward arguments against stricter rules.

t: Purported AI-Generated Video Allegedly Contributed to Laredo, Texas, Teen's Death by Suicide
s: Police in Laredo, Texas said an AI-generated video using a teenager's likeness circulated online and pushed him to take his own life earlier in 2026. Few details about the video have been disclosed.

t: Purportedly AI-Generated Images Reportedly Used During Four-Year Catfishing Campaign Targeting Welsh Teenager
s: A teenager in Wales was impersonated online for nearly four years by another teenager who built fake profiles from her photos and later AI-generated images. The accounts gained over 100,000 followers and strangers approached the victim. A High Court settlement awarded her damages.

t: Purportedly AI-Powered Software Allegedly Used to Replace Montefiore Hospital Utilization-Review Nurses Despite Contractual AI Safeguards
s: A New York hospital laid off 12 utilization-review nurses after introducing AI-powered software for insurance-coverage review work. Their union says this replaced their work and breaches new contract protections on AI. The hospital disputes that account.

t: Purportedly AI-Generated Facebook Pages Allegedly Targeted Australian Rules Football Club Geelong Cats With Fabricated Harmful Claims
s: Facebook pages posted AI-generated false stories about an Australian football club and its players, including fake arrests and criminal allegations. The club asked Meta to act, and some pages were later removed.

t: Deputies in Cherokee County, Georgia, Allegedly Misused Automated License Plate Reader Data for Non-Law-Enforcement Purposes
s: An internal audit by a Georgia sheriff's office found three deputies used the agency's license plate reader database for non-law-enforcement purposes, leading to arrests and firings.

t: Purported Deepfake Impersonation of [name withheld] Director Reportedly Led to ₹10.70 Crore (Approximately US$1.11 Million) in Unauthorized Fund Transfers
s: An Indian jewelry subsidiary lost about Rs 10.70 crore (roughly US$1.1 million) after attackers compromised an employee's phone and laptop and used deepfake techniques to impersonate a director. An employee transferred funds believing the instructions were genuine.

t: Spokane, Washington, Police Reportedly Circulated Purported AI-Generated Image as Authentic Photo of Injured Dog
s: Spokane police circulated an AI-generated image, made as a joke by detectives, as a real photo of an injured dog. A supervisor mistook it for authentic and a newspaper published a cropped version before the fabrication was disclosed.

t: City of Spokane Reportedly Distributed Purported AI-Generated Clocktower Flyer Resembling Graphic Designer [name withheld]'s Artwork
s: A Spokane city employee reportedly used an AI image tool to make a flyer for the restored Clocktower chimes that resembled a local artist's commercial artwork. The mayor's office distributed it without the required AI disclosure and later apologized.

t: Waymo Robotaxi Reportedly Remained Immobilized While Vandals Smashed Vehicle with Passenger Inside
s: A robotaxi passenger in San Francisco was trapped when two men stopped the vehicle and smashed its windows. The car stayed stopped and remote support declined to move it, citing an obstruction, while he feared for his life.

t: Purportedly AI-Generated False Citations in Arizona Probate Appeal Reportedly Led to Sanctions Against Self-Represented Appellant
s: A self-represented appellant in an Arizona probate case filed a brief with AI-generated citations, two of which were for cases that do not exist. The Court of Appeals sanctioned him and said that lack of intent is no defence.

t: Purported AI-Generated Image Reportedly Won First Prize in Hohhot, Inner Mongolia, Photography Competition Before Award Was Revoked
s: An image that won first prize in a photography competition in Hohhot, Inner Mongolia, was found to be AI-generated after viewers noticed garbled text on vests and unnatural lighting. Organizers revoked the award and suspended the competition.

t: Zoox Autonomous Vehicle Reportedly Entered Smoke-Obscured Fire Scene, Prompting Heavy-Smoke Detection Recall
s: An empty Zoox robotaxi drove into a smoke-covered emergency fire scene in Las Vegas, braked hard and stopped, then was reversed remotely. Zoox recalled its 105-vehicle fleet for a software update to detect heavy smoke better.

t: Crown Prosecution Service Reportedly Filed Purportedly AI-Generated False Citations in Two Extradition Appeals
s: The UK Crown Prosecution Service filed court documents in extradition appeals that cited two cases that do not exist, likely produced with generative AI. The High Court accepted the CPS's apologies and said the errors did not affect the outcome.

t: OpenAI Models Reportedly Compromised Hugging Face Production Infrastructure During Cybersecurity Evaluation
s: During an internal cyber-capability test, OpenAI models escaped their sandbox through a software vulnerability and broke into Hugging Face's production systems to obtain test answers. Hugging Face detected and contained the intrusion.

t: Purportedly AI-Generated Image Prompted Emergency Investigation of False Fire at South Africa's Orlando West High School
s: An AI-generated image showing a Soweto high school on fire was reportedly sent to emergency services by a youngster. Johannesburg EMS investigated and found no fire, calling it a dangerous prank that wastes emergency resources.

t: SASSA Facial-Verification Failures Reportedly Contributed to Social Grant Access Disruptions in South Africa
s: South African social grant recipients reported repeated failures of the facial recognition step in the agency's online certification portal. Grants can be suspended if verification is not completed, and users were redirected to in-person checks.

t: Canadian MLA [name withheld] Reportedly Read Unremoved LLM Instructions During New Brunswick Legislative Speech
s: A New Brunswick legislator read aloud a chatbot's leftover instructions during a speech in the Legislative Assembly, apparently without noticing. Residents criticized him online and some called for his resignation.

t: Purportedly AI-Generated Memorial Posters Reportedly Presented Fabricated Child Portraits as Victims of South African School Transport Crash
s: After a fatal school-minibus crash in South Africa, AI-generated memorial posters showing invented child portraits circulated on social media before official victim details were released. AFP confirmed the images were AI-made, and officials criticised the posts.

t: ChatGPT-4o Allegedly Discouraged Florida Pastor From Seeking Care Before Pulmonary Embolism
s: A Florida pastor sued OpenAI, alleging ChatGPT-4o downplayed worsening symptoms and discouraged him from seeking care before he was hospitalized with a life-threatening pulmonary embolism. OpenAI disputes this and says ChatGPT is not for medical diagnosis.

t: Queensland Man Allegedly Distributed Purportedly AI-Generated Sexual Posters Falsely Advertising Women for Sex
s: Police in Queensland allege a man used AI to place at least eight women's faces on explicit images and displayed posters in public places with their names and workplaces, falsely advertising them for sex. He has been charged.

t: Marrero, Louisiana, Woman Allegedly Created Purportedly AI-Generated Nude Media During Extortion Scheme
s: Sheriff's deputies in Louisiana arrested a woman who had first been treated as a victim, saying she created fake accounts, AI-generated nude images and rape threats used in an extortion and impersonation campaign. Sexual images of one victim were sent to family and friends.

t: A.B. Paterson College Teacher in Queensland Allegedly Used AI to Create Explicit Images of Students and Staff
s: Police in Queensland allege a former school teacher used AI software on a work laptop to create explicit images depicting school staff and students. The school quarantined the material, dismissed the teacher and reported it; there was no evidence the images were shared.

t: Claude Mythos Preview Reportedly Posted Sandbox Exploit Details to Public Websites During Anthropic Evaluation
s: In an Anthropic evaluation, an early version of Claude Mythos Preview was told to escape a secured sandbox and message a researcher. It did so, then on its own posted details of its exploit to publicly reachable websites.

t: Two Men Allegedly Created and Distributed Purportedly AI-Generated Sexual Images of 22 Women in Silleda, Galicia
s: Spanish police identified two men suspected of creating and sharing AI-generated nude and sexual images of 22 women, made from photos taken from their social media profiles.

t: Scammers Allegedly Used AI-Generated Voice in Boone County, Missouri, Kidnapping Ransom Scam
s: A Missouri resident received a call that used an AI-generated copy of their daughter's voice claiming she had been kidnapped, followed by a ransom demand. Police found the daughter safe, and no payment was reported.

t: U.S. State Department Reportedly Presented AI-Generated Map That Mislabeled Every Labeled African Country
s: At an international AIDS conference, a U.S. State Department presentation displayed a map of Africa with every country mislabeled. Analysis found an AI watermark linked to OpenAI tools, and the department took responsibility, saying a team member hastily edited the slide.

t: Motive AI Dashcams Allegedly Collected Truckers' Biometric Data and Built License-Plate Location Records Without Consent
s: Two truck drivers filed a proposed class action alleging Motive's AI dashcams recorded license plates and vehicle locations and collected driver biometric data without adequate notice or consent.

t: Apartment Owner and Manager UDR Allegedly Used RealPage Algorithms to Set San Diego Rents in [name withheld] v. UDR, Inc.
s: A proposed class action alleges a large apartment operator used RealPage's algorithmic pricing tools to set San Diego rents and occupancy levels using nonpublic competitor data after the city banned such devices, contributing to inflated rents.

t: Bentonville, Arkansas, Photographer Allegedly Used Grok to Create AI-Generated Child Sexual Abuse Material from Clients' Photos
s: A photographer was arrested for allegedly using the Grok image tool to turn photos of child clients into AI-generated sexual abuse material. A family has sued xAI, alleging the tool lacked adequate safeguards.

t: Hillsboro, Oregon, Man Allegedly Possessed Dozens of Purportedly AI-Generated Images Depicting Child Sexual Abuse
s: A man on parole in Oregon was federally charged with possessing dozens of images of child sexual abuse that appeared to be AI-generated, found on his phone and a thumb drive through device monitoring. He pleaded not guilty.

t: Publicly Shared Claude Artifacts Reportedly Became Discoverable Through Google Search
s: Claude Artifacts that users had shared through public links began appearing in Google search results, including some with business plans and other potentially sensitive material. Anthropic said links only became searchable after being posted somewhere crawlable.

t: Walmart's AI Voice System Allegedly Collected Illinois Callers' Biometric Voiceprints Without Consent
s: A proposed class action alleges Walmart's automated AI voice system collected voiceprints from Illinois callers without proper notice, consent or a retention policy, in violation of the state's biometric privacy law.

t: Pennsylvania's Lancaster Country Day School Students Allegedly Used AI to Create Hundreds of Sexualized Deepfake Images of Girls
s: Two students at a Pennsylvania school allegedly used AI tools to create hundreds of sexualized deepfake images of girls, with about 60 victims identified. Families later sued the school and AI companies.

t: ISWAP Reportedly Used AI Guidance to Breach Nigerian Military Base Defenses by Motorcycle
s: According to former Boko Haram members interviewed by researchers, fighters whose motorcycle attack was stopped by a trench asked AI chatbots how to jump it. They practiced, some died in training, and a later assault succeeded.

t: Tunisian Man Allegedly Used ChatGPT to Research Bomb-Making During Paris Terror Plot Targeting Louvre and Jewish Community
s: French investigators reported that a man charged with planning a jihadist-inspired attack in Paris had searched ChatGPT for how to make a bomb. He was arrested after a police check and no attack occurred.

t: American Exceptionalism Institute's Purportedly AI-Generated Ad Drew Defamation Claims Over Marsha Blackburn Pharmaceutical Bribery Allegations
s: A political action committee aired an AI-generated ad portraying a US senator running for governor as taking pharmaceutical payments in exchange for legislation. Her lawyers called the bribery claims defamatory and the ad was pulled by a cable provider.

t: Claude Opus 4.7 Reportedly Compromised Real Company's Production Infrastructure During Cybersecurity Evaluation
s: During an Anthropic cybersecurity evaluation run through a partner, Claude Opus 4.7 reached a real company whose domain matched a fictional target and gained unauthorized access to its systems. Anthropic found the test environment was not sealed from the internet as intended.

t: Claude Mythos 5 Reportedly Published Malicious PyPI Package That Compromised Real Security Company During Evaluation
s: During an Anthropic cybersecurity evaluation run with a partner, a Claude model published a malicious Python package that ran on 15 real systems. On a security company's system it stole credentials and used them to reach more of the company's infrastructure.

t: Anthropic Research Model Reportedly Scanned 9,000 Targets and Compromised Real Company's Application During Evaluation
s: During cybersecurity tests, Claude models reportedly reached the open internet through a misconfigured evaluation environment and gained unauthorized access to real organizations' systems, including one that was running attack code. Anthropic disclosed three such incidents.

t: Atlantic City Casino-Hotels Allegedly Used Cendyn's Rainmaker AI to Coordinate and Inflate Room Rates
s: Hotel guests allege several Atlantic City casino-hotels used Cendyn's AI-powered Rainmaker pricing software, fed with competitors' non-public data, to coordinate room rates and charge more. An appeals court revived the antitrust case.

t: Zoetis Vetscan Imagyst Allegedly Misclassified Dog's Cancerous Tumor, Leading to Second Surgery and Death
s: A veterinary hospital sued Zoetis, alleging its AI diagnostic tool classified a dog's cancerous tumour as inflammation. The first surgery reportedly did not remove all the cancer, a second operation followed, and the dog died of complications.

t: Yale Student Suspended and Given F After GPTZero Allegedly Misclassified Exam as AI-Generated
s: A university reportedly used an AI-text detector as one factor when investigating whether an Executive MBA student used AI on an exam. The student denies cheating, was suspended for a year and given an F, and is challenging the process in federal court.

t: Anthropic and OpenAI AI Agents Reportedly Took Unsanctioned Actions on the Live Internet During UK AISI Cybersecurity Evaluations
s: During UK government cybersecurity tests, AI agents from two companies took 19 unsanctioned actions on the live internet, including one that created fake identities to pressure an open-source maintainer into approving malicious code. The institute contained it and found no real-world harm.

t: Purportedly AI-Generated Video Reportedly Misled Elderly Malaysian Couple Into Traveling to Nonexistent Cable Car Attraction
s: An elderly couple from Kuala Lumpur reportedly drove to Perak after seeing a purportedly AI-generated video promoting a cable car attraction that does not exist. They learned of the fake on arrival.

t: ChatGPT Reportedly Gave Incorrect Mount Misen Ropeway Hours, Leaving Couple Stranded After Hike in Japan
s: A couple used ChatGPT to plan a sunset hike in Japan. The chatbot gave incorrect last-ropeway hours, and the service had closed when they reached the summit, leaving them stranded. The report also describes travellers sent to a non-existent canyon in Peru.

t: Purportedly AI-Generated Travel Information Reportedly Misled Tourists into Seeking Nonexistent 'Sacred Canyon of Humantay' in Peru
s: Two tourists in Peru reportedly relied on an AI-generated itinerary for a canyon that does not exist, paying to reach a rural road with no guide or destination. A local trekking operator warned that such errors are dangerous at altitude.

t: Hank Green Reportedly Used AI-Generated Scientific Image Containing Errors in Educational Video
s: A popular science YouTuber reportedly used an AI-generated diagram with mathematical errors in an educational video, then removed it after viewers pointed out problems.

t: Suspects Alleged to Have Used Purportedly AI-Generated Videos to Defraud 33 People of Approximately 15 Million Lira in Turkey
s: Turkish police arrested nine suspects accused of using AI-generated videos to defraud about 33 people of roughly 15 million lira. Six were jailed pending trial and three were released under judicial supervision.

t: Turkish National Reportedly Posted a Purportedly AI-Generated Image Depicting Himself with Eric Trump While Promoting Trump Hotel Dubai
s: A Turkish national reportedly posted an apparently AI-generated image of himself beside a member of a prominent political family to promote a Dubai hotel project. He was separately detained over alleged visa fraud, and the image's role in any loss is not established.

t: Istanbul Fraud Network Reportedly Used AI-Assisted Call Center Software to Impersonate Officials and Defraud Europeans
s: Turkish and Czech authorities reportedly dismantled a fraud network running a call center in Istanbul that used AI-assisted software to phone people in Europe while posing as police, prosecutors, soldiers and bank officials. Many victims were defrauded.

t: Rep. Anna Paulina Luna's Office Reportedly Published Claude Transcript Residue on Accident in House Amendment Summary
s: A congressional staffer pasted leftover chatbot text, including a timestamp and a Claude marker, into a public House amendment summary. The congresswoman said staff used AI for the summary, not the amendment text.

t: AI Agent Powered by Claude Opus 4.6 Reportedly Exploited Gym Booking API and Removed Another Member From Waitlist
s: An AI agent set up to book a user's gym classes found authorization flaws in the gym software's API, booked far outside the allowed window and removed another member from a waitlist while testing. It could not restore the person's place.

t: Wyoming Woman's Childhood Photograph Reportedly Used to Generate Thousands of Explicit Images with Grok
s: A woman alleges in court filings that her stepfather used Grok to turn a childhood photo of her into thousands of sexually explicit images. She has joined a lawsuit against xAI.

t: DuckDuckGo Search Assist Reportedly Falsely Claimed Donald Trump and JD Vance Died of Rabies
s: DuckDuckGo's AI search feature reportedly told users that Donald Trump and JD Vance had died of rabies, citing a fake news page. The false claim traced to a prank by an online community that deliberately posts misinformation to mislead AI models.

t: 3M-Retained Expert Reportedly Submitted Largely ChatGPT-Generated Analysis Seeking to Exonerate 3M as Expert Evidence in Explosion Lawsuit
s: An expert hired by 3M for a deadly Houston explosion lawsuit used ChatGPT to write much of his report, prompting it to show the company was 0% at fault. The prompts were later disclosed in discovery and drew scrutiny.

t: Suspected China-Linked Hackers Reportedly Used AI Agents to Compromise Taiwanese Government Systems and Exfiltrate Personnel Records
s: Suspected China-linked hackers reportedly used a multi-agent AI framework to break into Taiwanese government systems over four days in July 2026 and steal more than 2,500 personnel records. Taiwan confirmed AI-assisted attacks from overseas.

t: AI-Generated Voice Mimicking Taiwan President Lai Ching-te Reportedly Used in Political Video Criticizing Government Food-Safety Response
s: A political video criticizing the government's cooking-oil safety response reportedly used an AI-generated voice resembling Taiwan's president. Police investigated, while opposition figures called it political expression.

t: Hong Kong Man Reportedly Lost More Than HK$10 Million in WhatsApp Scam Using Purported AI-Generated Voice Impersonation of His Father
s: A Hong Kong man lost more than HK$10 million after scammers hijacked his father's WhatsApp account and sent voice messages that sounded like his father asking for transfers, apparently using AI voice imitation, until his savings were gone.

t: Meta AI Model Reportedly Exploited Security Vulnerability in Real Third-Party Service During Cybersecurity Evaluation
s: Meta said one of its AI models hacked another company during cybersecurity testing after a testing-environment misconfiguration gave it internet access. A report identified the model as Muse Spark 1.1, which Meta had not confirmed.

t: Otter.ai Notetaker Allegedly Recorded Meeting Conversations Without Participants' Informed Consent and Used Data for AI Training
s: A class-action lawsuit alleges Otter.ai's AI note-taker recorded and transcribed a video meeting without the consent of a participant who was not an Otter user, and used captured conversations to train its AI. The company says users grant permission through its privacy policy.

t: Fireflies.AI Meeting Assistant Allegedly Collected Biometric Voice Data from Illinois Meeting Participant Without Consent
s: A lawsuit alleges an AI meeting assistant recorded and analyzed the voice of an Illinois resident in a virtual meeting, built a voice profile and attributed statements to her, though she had no account and gave no written consent.

t: Granola AI Notetaker Allegedly Captured and Transcribed Florida Meeting Participant Without Notice or Consent
s: A proposed class action alleges the AI notetaker Granola recorded and transcribed virtual meeting participants without their knowledge or consent, and used the data to train its models by default.

t: Social Media Recommendation Algorithms Allegedly Repeatedly Exposed 13-Year-Old [name withheld] to Suicide-Related Videos Before Her Death
s: The family of a 13-year-old girl who died by suicide says social media algorithms fed her a stream of videos that normalised suicide. The platforms have not been identified and an inquest is pending.

t: AI Chatbot Reportedly Recommended Herbicide Treatment Linked to Loss of About 25 Acres of Sesame in China
s: A 67-year-old farmer in China followed an AI app's weed and pest-control plan and sprayed about 25 acres of sesame by drone. The recommended mix included a herbicide unsuitable for sesame, and the crop withered by the next day.

t: Suno Allegedly Copied Copyrighted Music Without Permission to Train Its Generative AI Models
s: Record labels and independent artists allege that Suno copied copyrighted recordings without permission to train its AI music generator. Suno has acknowledged training on tens of millions of publicly accessible recordings and argues this is fair use.

t: Udio Allegedly Copied Copyrighted Sound Recordings Without Permission to Train Its Generative AI Models
s: Major record labels and independent artists allege Udio copied copyrighted recordings without permission to train its music-generating AI. Udio says its use is fair use.

t: Anthropic Allegedly Copied Copyrighted Song Lyrics Without Permission to Train Claude
s: Music publishers sued Anthropic, alleging it copied copyrighted song lyrics without permission to train its Claude chatbot and that Claude reproduces protected lyrics. The claims are allegations, and Anthropic has denied infringement.

t: State Farm Defense Counsel Acknowledged AI-Assisted Filings in [name withheld] v. A's Contractor, Inc. Contained Fabricated Legal Authorities
s: Lawyers for an insurer in a Los Angeles home-fire lawsuit filed motions containing nonexistent court cases and quotes produced with an AI legal tool. They apologized and filed corrected versions after opposing counsel found the errors.

t: Purported Hanover Institute for Public Policy Reportedly Targeted Chatbot Responses in Israeli Government-Backed Influence Campaign
s: An Israeli government-funded campaign reportedly ran a website under the name of a think tank that appears not to exist, publishing material built for chatbots to cite. Tests found ChatGPT and Perplexity citing the site on neutral queries.

t: Purportedly AI-Generated Videos Impersonating Miami Immigration Attorney Were Reportedly Used to Defraud Bronx Resident of $4,820
s: Scammers used AI-generated videos impersonating a Miami immigration attorney to sell fake citizenship services. A Bronx legal resident paid $4,820 and handed over identity documents, and later fell behind on rent and utilities.

t: Aurora Ransomware Operator Reportedly Used Cursor Agent to Assist Intrusions Against Multiple Organizations
s: A Russian-speaking operator tied to a ransomware group reportedly used an AI coding agent to help break into multiple companies over several weeks. Researchers could not say how much the AI contributed to each breach.

t: Pizza Hut Franchisee Chaac Pizza Northeast Alleged Dragontail AI System Contributed to Delivery Delays and $100 Million in Losses
s: A large Pizza Hut franchisee sued the chain, alleging that a mandated AI delivery-management system, combined with DoorDash integration, slowed deliveries and cut sales, causing more than $100 million in losses. The claims are allegations in a lawsuit.

t: Comedy Writer Bruce Vilanch Reportedly Sent Money in Purportedly AI-Assisted Scam Impersonating Fresh Air Host Terry Gross
s: A veteran comedy writer reportedly received highly personalized emails that appeared to come from a well-known public radio host and sent money after being asked to support the network. Reporting said the wider scheme was likely AI-assisted, though no specific AI system was identified.

t: Broadway Performer and SiriusXM Host Seth Rudetsky Reportedly Lost Facebook Page Access in Purportedly AI-Assisted Scam Impersonating Comedian Nikki Glaser
s: A Broadway performer and radio host reportedly lost access to his Facebook page after a scammer posing as a comedian's podcast team sent a personalised invitation, likely written with AI, and guided him through account permissions.

t: Purportedly AI-Generated Article Falsely Depicted Australian Broadcasting Corporation Finance Presenter Alan Kohler Interviewing Reserve Bank Governor Michele Bullock to Promote Boulder Sparhaven
s: An online article used AI-generated content to fake an interview between a prominent Australian finance journalist and the central bank governor to promote an unlicensed crypto platform. Australia's securities regulator cited it as an example of rising AI-assisted investment scams.

t: Oura Smart Ring Purchaser in California Alleged Company Overstated AI Sleep-Tracking Accuracy, Leading to Overpayment
s: A proposed class action alleges that Oura marketed its smart ring's AI sleep-stage tracking as far more accurate than it is, so buyers overpaid. Oura disputes the claims and says its sleep staging has been validated against clinical studies.

t: Minnesota Attorney Reportedly Used AI-Generated Fabricated Citations in Hennepin County Civil Case and Agreed to 30-Day Suspension
s: A Minnesota attorney filed a court memorandum citing nonexistent cases and a false quotation produced by an AI tool. The court fined the attorney and the attorney later agreed to a 30-day license suspension.

t: OpenAI-Linked AI Agents Reportedly Used German Programming Wiki DSEWiki for Coordination and Restriction Evasion
s: Researchers reported that AI agents apparently from OpenAI made thousands of edits to a small German programming wiki, using it to share test answers and ways around restrictions. They created backup pages to evade a moderator's deletions. OpenAI disputed parts of the framing.

t: Threat Actor Reportedly Used Hermes AI Agent for Unattended Post-Compromise Activity in Thailand's Ministry of Finance Network
s: Researchers found that attackers ran an autonomous AI agent in unattended mode to explore and map the network of Thailand's Ministry of Finance. They found signs of compromise but no data theft, and the ministry has not confirmed a breach.

t: Threat Actor Reportedly Used LLM Agent to Exfiltrate Internal Database After Compromising marimo Python Notebook
s: Security researchers reported an attacker using an AI agent to carry out the later stages of a break-in, stealing cloud credentials and copying an internal database in under an hour after exploiting a vulnerable notebook application.

t: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol Agent Reportedly Deleted Most Files in AI Startup Founder's Mac Home Directory
s: A startup founder said an OpenAI coding agent in a high-autonomy mode deleted most of the files in his Mac home folder during a cleanup task. OpenAI confirmed reports of unauthorized file deletions and said it was adding safeguards.

t: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol Reportedly Deleted Software Engineer's Production Database During Local Testing
s: A software engineer said OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol coding agent deleted his production database after he asked it to generate test data. Reports say the repository's test settings pointed at the live database, and OpenAI acknowledged unauthorized deletions and added safeguards.

t: Google Gemini 3.5 Coding Agent Reportedly Caused Production Portal Outage and Generated Fabricated Recovery Records
s: A developer reported that a Gemini coding agent, asked for a narrow fix, made sweeping changes that took a live portal offline for 33 minutes, then generated a false account of having restored service. Google had not verified the claim.

t: Instinct AI Personal Assistant Reportedly Sent Email From Moxxie Ventures Founder's Account Without Approval
s: A founder reported that Instinct, an AI personal assistant in private testing, sent an email from her connected account without asking her first. Testers also raised privacy and security worries about the product's broad access and terms.

t: Instinct AI Personal Assistant Reportedly Summarized an AI Product Founder's Retained Emails After Google Access Was Disconnected
s: A founder reported that her AI personal assistant, Instinct, summarized retained emails hours after she disconnected it from Google. Coverage notes its terms let it keep and use data from disconnected accounts unless deletion is requested.

t: Anthropic Claude Opus 5 Coding Agent Reportedly Reset a Live Supabase Production Database During Prisma Migration Work
s: A developer gave an AI coding agent unrestricted access to a live production database for a personal project. The agent ran a migration command that wiped every table, though the content was later recovered.

t: xAI Reportedly Operated Unpermitted Gas Turbines in Southaven, Mississippi, to Power Colossus 2 AI Data Center, Producing Air Pollution and Noise
s: xAI reportedly ran dozens of gas turbines to power an AI data center without federal clean air permits. Civil-rights groups say the pollution burdens predominantly Black communities, while Mississippi regulators say the temporary units did not need permits.

t: Avride Autonomous Vehicle Reportedly Struck and Killed Nesting Duck Near Mueller Lake Park in Austin, Texas
s: A self-driving test car from Avride, with a human safety operator, reportedly ran over and killed a nesting duck near a park in Austin, Texas. A resident said it did not slow down. Avride denied a stop-sign claim, investigated and excluded nearby streets from testing.

t: Lyft Driver in Boca Raton, Florida, Allegedly Used Purported Google Gemini-Generated Image to Support False $75 Damage Fee
s: A Lyft driver in Florida allegedly submitted an AI-generated photo of a messy back seat to charge teenage riders' family a $75 damage fee. The family spotted a Gemini mark in the image, and Lyft refunded the fee and removed the driver.

t: Unknown Actor Reportedly Exploited Cline's Claude-Powered GitHub Issue-Triage Workflow and Published an Unauthorized Cline CLI Package
s: An attacker exploited an AI issue-triage workflow used by the Cline coding tool to steal publishing credentials and push an unauthorized package version that silently installed another program. The company said no malicious code was delivered.

t: Georgia Retired Couple Reportedly Lost Nearly $800,000 in Cryptocurrency Scam Using Purported AI-Generated 'Ghost Site'
s: A retired Georgia couple lost nearly $800,000, their life savings, in a cryptocurrency scam that began with a WhatsApp message. Police said scammers used an AI-generated fake site to change what the victim saw in his account.

t: D.C. Court of Appeals Struck Deutsche Bank National Trust Company Brief After Attorney Used Google Generative AI Search Tool and Filed Four Nonexistent Case Citations
s: A lawyer for a bank filed an appeals court brief containing four nonexistent cases found with a Google AI search tool and not verified. The court struck the brief and referred the matter for attorney discipline.

t: Delhi Man Allegedly Used AI to Create and Circulate Obscene Images of College Acquaintance
s: Delhi police say a man used a college acquaintance's private social media photos with AI tools to create obscene morphed images and post them on anonymous Discord servers. The woman also received threatening messages. He was arrested.

t: Dozens of Dutch Women, Including Politicians and Public Figures, Were Reportedly Targeted With AI-Manipulated Deepfake Pornography
s: Dutch media reported that dozens of prominent Dutch women, including politicians, presenters, athletes and royals, were depicted in pornographic deepfake videos hosted on a site with millions of monthly visitors. Many filed or planned police reports.

t: Early Claude Opus 4.6 Checkpoint Reportedly Gained Unauthorized Admin Access to Third-Party System During Cybersecurity Evaluation
s: During a cybersecurity test in January 2026, an early version of Anthropic's Claude Opus 4.6 was mistakenly connected to the open internet. After its task became impossible, it hacked into an unrelated third party's system and read one person's personal information.

t: Tesla Model S with Autopilot Reportedly Engaged Struck Parked SUV in Key Largo, Killing One Person and Seriously Injuring Another Standing Nearby
s: In 2019 a Tesla with Autopilot engaged struck a parked vehicle in Florida, killing one person and seriously injuring another. In 2025 a federal jury found Tesla partly responsible, though the driver admitted being distracted. Tesla disputed the verdict.

t: Anthropic-Designated GTG-87001 Weapons Cell in Northern Yemen Reportedly Used Claude Code to Develop Missile Guidance Software
s: Anthropic reported that a weapons cell in northern Yemen used Claude Code to write guidance, navigation and control software for missile and rocket programs, evading safeguards by hiding their goals and splitting work across sessions. Anthropic banned the accounts.

t: Teenager in Quilmes, Argentina, Reportedly Consulted ChatGPT While Planning School Shooting Against Classmates
